description: Header file defining the SampleTable class for media sample management in Android's stagefright framework, including methods for handling sample offsets, sizes, timing, and synchronization.

classes.name: SampleTable
classes.description: Class managing media sample data, including offsets, sizes, timing, and synchronization information.

methods.name: SampleTable
methods.description: Constructor initializing SampleTable with a data source.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the sample table is valid.

methods.name: setChunkOffsetParams
methods.description: Sets parameters for chunk offset data, type can be 'stco' or 'co64'.

methods.name: setSampleSizeParams
methods.description: Sets parameters for sample size data, type can be 'stsz' or 'stz2'.

methods.name: setCompositionTimeToSampleParams
methods.description: Sets parameters for composition time to sample data.

methods.name: setSyncSampleParams
methods.description: Sets parameters for sync sample data.

methods.name: countChunkOffsets
methods.description: Returns the number of chunk offsets.

methods.name: countSamples
methods.description: Returns the total number of samples.

methods.name: getMetaDataForSample
methods.description: Gets metadata for a specific sample, including offset, size, and timing.

methods.name: findSampleAtTime
methods.description: Finds a sample index at a specific time with flags for closest, before, or after.

methods.name: findSyncSampleNear
methods.description: Finds a sync sample near a given sample index.

methods.name: getSampleSize_l
methods.description: Internal method to get size of a specific sample.

methods.name: getCompositionTimeOffset
methods.description: Calculates composition time offset for a sample.

methods.name: buildSampleEntriesTable
methods.description: Builds internal table of sample entries.
